prompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: Daggerfall Unity retro pixel-art NPC speech-mouth atlas, portrait record 86.
Input image: the supplied mouth-reference-grid.png is the identity and geometry authority. It is a 3x3 grid of repeated original lower portrait halves, each enlarged 8x.
Primary request: Edit the reference into one NEUTRAL speech-mouth atlas. Keep the same woman and exact identity. Create nine equal cells in row-major order A B C / D E F / G H X. Each cell depicts the same lower half at native 64x29 proportions. Keep original mouth position and lip scale. Change mouth pose only; preserve nose, cheeks, chin, face width, skin, hair, neck and background.
Required Rhubarb mouth meanings:
A closed, lightly pressured lips for P/B/M.
B narrow horizontal opening with teeth nearly together for consonants/EE.
C medium relaxed, unrounded opening for EH/AE.
D wide vertical AA opening, larger than C.
E slightly rounded AO/ER opening, no wider than C.
F small forward pucker for UW/OW/W; not tooth biting.
G upper teeth touching lower lip for F/V; not a wide vowel or pucker.
H tongue raised behind upper teeth for L, opening between C and D; tiny tongue may be invisible at 64px.
X relaxed closed idle.
Emotion and color: neutral relaxed articulation, consistent pose families. Preserve muted warm tan skin, softly blended pixel-art contrast and original soft brown lips. Teeth, where needed, are small and subdued warm ivory, never bright white blocks. Use true native pixel clusters after downsampling; avoid smooth vector shapes, exaggerated jaw opening or enlarged mouth.
Constraints: no lipstick-red lips, orange skin, halo, hard dark outline, white flashes, new facial details, text, borders, extra panels, watermark, face resizing or crop changes. A and X should stay visually closed and close to the reference; final assembly restores them exactly to source.
